name: Gemini 4 Argon
summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's flagship reasoning model, built for complex software engineering, math and science problems and autonomous multi-step agents. It has a 1M-token context shared between input and output, with an optional long-decode mode that can produce up to 1M output tokens.
facts: 65,536 tokens default; up to 1M with long decode
Function calling, code execution, search grounding, computer use (preview)
goodFor: Very long outputs via long decode
Multimodal input incl. video and audio
watchOut: No explicit context caching, implicit only
Paid tier only in the Gemini API
